ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence before formation; screen all shareholders, directors, signatories, UBOs and material counterparties against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU consolidated list, and Panamanian domestic financial intelligence and police watchlists. Enhanced due diligence is required for domestic, foreign and international-organization PEPs, including family members and close associates, with ongoing monitoring for at least 12 months after a PEP status ends. Negative-match results must be documented and retained for at least five years under Law 23 of 2015.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Portal de Servicios en Línea del Registro Público de Panamá (online services of the Panama Public Registry; www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin script and are recorded in Spanish. Names may be in Spanish, English or another Latin-alphabet language, but must contain a recognized corporate identifier under Law 32 of 1927 (e.g. 'S.A.', 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd.'). The exact reserved spelling controls; accents and punctuation are considered for identity comparison, and any variation requires a fresh name-search certificate.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO / BANK / BANKING — requires prior authorization from the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá
SEGUROS / INSURANCE / REASEGUROS / FIANZA / SURETY — requires prior authorization from the insurance supervisory authority
FINANCIERA / FINANCE / MICROFINANCIERA — requires financial-activity license; generally prohibited in an ordinary S.A.
FIDEICOMISO / TRUST / TRUSTEE — requires Panamanian banking/trust authorization
BOLSA / STOCK EXCHANGE / VALORES / MERCADO DE VALORES — requires securities supervisory authorization
CASINO / SLOTS / APUESTAS / GAMBLING / BETTING — regulated gaming tokens; acceptable only with a clear social-casino/simulation disclaimer and no regulated-gaming license implication
LOTERÍA / NATIONAL LOTTERY — protected by state concession rules
RED CROSS / CRUZ ROJA / UNIVERSIDAD / MINISTERIO / MUNICIPAL / POLICÍA — protected or misleading official-designation tokens requiring special authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Obtain the official search certificate and rejection grounds in writing from the Panama Public Registry. If the name is refused as identical or confusingly similar, prepare an amended name or request an administrative review. File a 'Recurso de Apelación' with the Dirección General del Registro Público within ten business days of notice, attaching the original search receipt, the proposed articles of incorporation, and any notarized authority. If the Registry upholds the refusal, pursue judicial review before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo of the Suprema Corte de Justicia, or simultaneously reserve a new name; a reservation may be left to lapse and refiled if no opposition matures.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this digital social-casino publisher. Law 32 of 1927 requires only a Panamanian resident agent and a registered office in Panama; no physical operating premises are required for an unlicensed software/simulated-gaming publisher. A licensed registered agent's office can serve as the registered office and accept service of process. Corporate substance should still be documented (IP ownership, board decisions, accounting records) to preserve territorial tax treatment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 10% annual likelihood for an unlicensed digital publisher without land-based operations; would rise above 50% if a regulated gaming license or physical premises were added).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of Panama), as amended, arts. 1-52 governing formation, share capital, directors, officers, registered office, and resident agency requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil, Dirección General de Registro (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the Pacto Social and Estatutos (protocolized articles of incorporation and bylaws)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 32 de 1927; authorized capital may be expressed in balboas or US dollars, and paid-up capital may be set at the minimum par value. No escrow account is required for a standard Panamanian Sociedad Anónima.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriptions and share allocations of the Corporation are approved as recorded in the share subscription book; the shares are issued for lawful consideration and the paid-up capital is accepted as set forth in the incorporation record. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation in the Republic of Panama, located at the address of the resident agent, is formally adopted for the receipt of official notices and statutory service. RESOLVED, that the persons named in the secretary's certificate are elected the initial directors and officers of the Corporation, each to serve until the next annual shareholders' meeting or until earlier resignation. RESOLVED, that the resident agent and officers be, and hereby are, authorized to execute all necessary documents for public registration, municipal licensing, and banking operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section / Electronic Name Reservation Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed Spanish-language corporate names through the Public Registry's denomination reservation portal or in person at the Mercantile Section. Indicate the exact corporate purpose and proposed authorized capital. The reservation is valid for 30 days. No notarization is required for this step.
required_dossiers: Completed corporate name reservation form
Copy of the incorporator's or resident agent's passport or national ID
List of up to three proposed corporate denominations
Brief description of the corporate purpose (software publishing and digital content activities)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or protected use, the next preferred denomination is automatically considered; alternatively file a written reconsideration request with the Dirección General de Registro using a new list of distinct names.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, Execute and Notarize the Pacto Social and Estatutos
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian Notary Public (Notario Público) in the First Judicial Circuit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws in Spanish, including corporate purpose, registered office address, resident agent, authorized capital, share classes, and initial directors. Founding shareholders execute the instrument, and the notary protocols it as an Escritura Pública. Shareholders acting remotely must execute through a notarized power of attorney granted to the Panamanian resident agent or filing counsel.
required_dossiers: Notarized draft of the Pacto Social and Estatutos
Passport or national ID copies of all founding shareholders
Power of attorney for each foreign shareholder, if any
Acceptance letter of the Panamanian resident agent
Corporate name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies clauses inconsistent with Ley 32 de 1927 or incomplete corporate data, the instrument is re-executed or amended by notarial addendum before submission to the Public Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay Fees and File for Commercial Registry Inscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section, Inscription Counter
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the certified protocolized Escritura Pública, the registration application, and payment of registry tariffs at the Public Registry. All corporate filings must be routed through an attorney authorized to practice in Panama. The registry will assign a corporate number and issue the inscription certificate after validation.
required_dossiers: Certified copies of the Escritura Pública
Registration application form
Receipt of payment of registry fees
Corporate name reservation certificate
Resident agent's acceptance and identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a defect notice, file a corrective addendum with the certified rectification and pay any additional tariff. Unaffected clauses will not be re-reviewed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Legal Existence and Registered Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Certification Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After inscription, request a certified copy of the inscription certificate and, if needed, a Personería Jurídica certificate. Verify the exact corporate name, registration date, registry number, and the appointment of the resident agent and officers as recorded.
required_dossiers: Registered Escritura Pública or registration certificate
Registry fee payment receipt
Identification document of the applicant attorney or agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certification is delayed because of outstanding registry findings, pay any remaining tariff or provide the notarial addendum requested by the registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convene Organizational Board Meeting and Initiate Municipal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Office of the Sociedad Anónima; Municipio de Panamá – Aviso de Operación Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational first board meeting at the registered office or by valid electronic meeting procedure. The board ratifies share subscription, registered office, and officer appointments; then executes the written organizational resolutions. The resident agent physically obtains the certified incorporation documents. Following formation, file the Aviso de Operación with the Municipality and register with the Dirección General de Ingresos for tax identification.
required_dossiers: Organizational board resolution minutes
Certificate of incorporation and personería jurídica
Passport copies of directors and officers
Registered office lease or address authorization
Municipal Aviso de Operación application
Tax identification registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal authority questions the virtual slots activity, provide a legal opinion confirming that simulated social casino games without cash payouts do not constitute regulated gambling under Panamanian gaming law and are not real-money wagering.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – software publishing under ISIC 5820 does not require an industrial or manufacturing license in Panama
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operating Notice) – mandatory municipal business registration with the Municipality of Panama

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); electronic portal: Sede Electrónica de la DGI at https://www.dgi.gob.pa, which is the mandatory channel for RUC registration, ITBMS and ISR filings, e-invoicing validation, and tax certificates. Ancillary registries: Registro Público de Panamá (corporate incorporation) and the Municipality of the registered office (Aviso de Operación/business license).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders operate through a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) incorporated by a licensed resident agent. SOP: (1) execute and register the incorporation deed at the Public Registry; (2) obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación for the registered office location; (3) file the RUC/NIT registration application with the DGI, attaching the normalized corporate documents, the Aviso de Operación, the resident agent's power of attorney, identification documents of directors and the beneficial owner, and the declared economic activity code (ISIC 5820); (4) activate the Sede Electrónica e-Tax profile using the issued RUC and obtain or register the taxpayer's digital signature; (5) maintain the RUC file updated (address, directors, shareholders, and any secondary tax roles such as withholding agent or digital-services intermediary). No minimum capital and no local ownership requirement; foreign-owned S.A. registration to operational status typically completes within 7-15 business days after incorporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope: the S.A. is a separate taxable corporation, not eligible for pass-through treatment; it is taxed only on Panama-source income at the standard 25% corporate income tax rate (Código Fiscal Art. 699), while foreign-source income is outside Panamanian income tax unless effectively connected with a Panama permanent establishment or local economic presence. The entity is not automatically a Tax_Exempt_Zone vehicle; preferential income tax treatment applies only if physically established in Panamá Pacífico, a Zona Libre, or under the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama has no U.S.-style check-the-box election and no OECD hybrid-mismatch election rules; the available elections are tax-regime options: (i) the optional ITBMS input-credit method (Crédito Fiscal Optativo, Art. 177-A of the Código Fiscal) in lieu of the statutory restricted-credit pro-ration; (ii) election of the annual ISR return with quarterly advance payments versus the optional simplified payment methodology under recent fiscal reforms; (iii) the Pequeño Contribuyente flat-quota regime for gross annual income up to PAB 400,000, which substitutes monthly ITBMS filings; and (iv) a one-time election on the taxable treatment of foreign branches or permanent establishments under the territorial-source rules. Multinationals commonly structure offshore service flows contractually rather than through entity-classification elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (Panama's VAT-type transfer tax, Código Fiscal Arts. 1057-1106-A), complemented by the special withholding/registration regime for digital services introduced by Law 151 of 2021 and applicable to non-resident digital platforms; no municipal sales tax layer other than the local Aviso de Operación fee, and no provincial GST in Panama.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Zero monetary threshold: any natural or juridical person that transfers goods, imports goods, or renders services in Panama must obtain a RUC before carrying out the first taxable act. The only de minimis simplification is the Pequeño Contribuyente regime for taxpayers with gross annual income not exceeding PAB 400,000 (balboa at par with the US dollar), under which full ITBMS monthly returns are replaced by a fixed monthly quota; this significantly constrains input-credit recovery and is unsuitable for a digital export operation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) applies in phased waves since 2021 under Law 91 of 2019 and DGI administrative resolutions. B2B and B2C invoices must be transmitted to the DGI Sede Electrónica via API/REST-FACTFEL EDI; the DGI validates each invoice in near-real time and returns an authorization number and hash, which replaces physical fiscal stamping as the condition of legal validity. Medium and large taxpayers transmit continuously; small taxpayers may batch at least daily. Revenue from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing must be reconciled with the authorized e-invoice records and reported on the monthly ITBMS return, including any reverse-charge or intermediary documentation for foreign end-users.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% ITBMS rate applies to (i) physical goods exported out of Panama evidenced by a customs export declaration (Código Fiscal Art. 1058), and (ii) services rendered by a Panamanian taxpayer to a non-resident beneficiary when the use, enjoyment, or exploitation of the service occurs entirely outside Panama (Código Fiscal Art. 1059, numeral 4, as developed by DGI regulations on service exports and by the digital-economy provisions of Law 151 of 2021). For the simulated social-casino application monetized through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing, zero-rating eligibility requires transactional evidence that each in-app purchase is attributable to a foreign end-user whose residence and consumption point are offshore (storefront country, payment billing address, and geo-IP); sales to users located in Panama are subject to the 7% ITBMS, or to the Law 151 withholding regime where invoicing is done offshore. Panama imposes no exchange-control repatriation deadline because the US dollar is legal tender; however, the 180-day documentary window for inward remittance is applied by DGI audit practice and bank compliance as the benchmark for recognizing exported-service proceeds, and input VAT attributable to zero-rated sales remains creditable under the optional credit regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: E-invoice at 0% ITBMS with DGI authorization number and the matching XML/AFZ attached in the Sede Electrónica

Customs Export Declaration (DUA) - required only if physical goods or promotional merchandise are dispatched from Panama; replaced for pure digital services by the DGI-accepted service-export certificate/invoice
Bill of Lading or AirWaybill - required only for physical export; for digital export, the app-store settlement report and platform revenue statement serve as the shipment-equivalent evidence
Inward Remittance Certificate - bank credit advice or SWIFT MT103 evidencing that proceeds of the exported services were credited to the Panamanian bank account
Executed commercial agreement with Apple and Google identifying PA_CORP as the seller of record, together with the App Store Connect and Google Play payment statements
End-user offshore-use evidence: aggregated report by storefront country, geo-IP geolocation, and payment billing addresses demonstrating consumption outside Panama
Corporate file of the S.A.: RUC certificate, Aviso de Operación, and normalized Public Registry certificate
Transfer-pricing or business-purpose documentation where a foreign affiliate acts as platform operator or payment intermediary
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI fiscalización procedures will verify the offshore use-and-enjoyment substance of the digital service export, reconcile Apple/Google settlement reports with declared gross revenue, and test the arm's-length character of any affiliated platform arrangement. On disallowance, the 0% rate is reversed, ITBMS is assessed at 7% on the gross consideration, and the taxpayer faces: (i) retrospective assessment within the general 5-year limitation period, extended to 10 years where no return was filed or fraud is found; (ii) a monthly late-payment surcharge of 10% up to a 100% cap plus moratory interest at 10% per annum; (iii) fines of up to 100% of the omitted tax for fraudulent omission; and (iv) criminal liability under the Código Fiscal for wilful evasion, exposing the S.A., its directors, and the resident agent to custodial sanctions, RUC suspension, and loss of the resident agent's license. Refunds of zero-rating excess credits are payable only after prior DGI desk or field verification and are not automatic in the presence of discrepancies with banking or platform data.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco Nacional de Panamá (fiscal agent) and Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as banking supervisor; Panama operates without an issuing central bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility in both current and capital account. The United States dollar is legal tender and the Panamanian balboa exists only as a subsidiary coin at parity. There are no exchange controls, no prior approval requirements for profit repatriation, and no currency conversion restrictions for non-resident shareholders. Dividends, capital returns, and cross-border payments settle freely in USD. Only standard bank-level source-of-funds and AML due diligence documents are required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender timeline or mandatory conversion ratio exists in Panama. Full dollarization means export receipts, including proceeds from digital publishing and app-store revenues, may be retained, disbursed, or repatriated without mandatory conversion to any local currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account and Capital Escrow Sub-Account
Operational USD Account with Enhanced Due Diligence Tier

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium as a primary treasury conduit. Offshore digital EMIs are not licensed banks in Panama and cannot provide Panamanian local settlement accounts. They may be used only as ancillary collection or disbursement gateways if licensed in their home jurisdictions, but all final liquidity must be routed into a SBP-licensed Panamanian bank to maintain statutory tax records, corporate substance, and beneficiary-owner transparency. A pure EMI structure without a local licensed bank relationship is not viable for the PA_CORP treasury blueprint.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Most tier-one Panamanian banks require at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner to attend an in-person onboarding/KYC interview, usually in Panama City. Remote opening is permitted only at bank discretion under strict internal SBP-compliant policies, generally requiring an apostilled power of attorney, notarised corporate resolutions, certified passport copies, and a live video interview. For a non-resident-owned S.A. in the medium-risk digital gaming segment, an initial physical appearance or attendance at a Panamanian consulate is the de facto commercial standard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Classification as a gaming-related company and the perceived social-casino risk, despite the absence of real-money wagering or prize payouts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform agreements with Apple App Store and Google Play; app store financial settlement reports; audited statement confirming the business provides strictly simulated credits with no redemption-for-cash mechanic; internal AML/KYC and sanctions-screening policy; certificate from legal counsel that no real-money gaming licence is required under Panamanian law; a narrative description of game mechanics distinguishing the business from regulated internet gambling.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity, legacy bearer-share stigma, or non-resident shareholder structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified public deed from Registro Público; DGI Beneficial Owner Registration (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) filing receipt; full shareholder registry and share transfer ledger; passport copies of directors and ultimate beneficial owners; professional reference letters from a Panama-licensed attorney and an accountant; sworn source-of-wealth declaration with supporting bank or investory statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Chargeback risk and refund volatility arising from consumer in-app purchases routed through Apple/Google payment rails.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Processor-level settlement statements; 12-month chargeback and refund history; app-store terms confirming Apple/Google act as commercial agents; internal customer-dispute and refund policy; cash-flow forecasts showing EBIT resilience; parent-company or shareholder guarantee if required; evidence of segregated operating funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low minimum capital, sudden inbound capital injection, or mismatch between declared business size and transaction velocity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share subscription agreements and paid-in capital proof; shareholders' capital contribution resolutions; source-of-funds statements from remitting banks; bank reference letters; annual financial projections; proof of actual operating costs such as cloud hosting, game development, licences, and staff payroll.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 for direct shareholder capital injections and MT202 COV where an intermediary bank is involved. The beneficiary account must be the Panamanian S.A.'s licensed bank account in USD. Payment reference must state clearly: 'Paid-in capital contribution to Sociedad Anónima PA_CORP, RUC registered, ISIC 5820 activity'. Attach the share subscription agreement, board/shareholder resolution, source-of-wealth questionnaire, and updated Beneficial Owner Registry certificate. No central bank conversion declaration is required because Panama has no FX exchange-control regime; however, the receiving bank must complete SBP-required transaction monitoring and enhanced due diligence. For material investments, a bank may request an executed subscription letter and a notarised corporate deed prior to credit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operational trade disbursements, use SWIFT MT103 with invoice, contract, and proof of performance. For high-value procurement of licences, servers, and intellectual-property services, use an irrevocable documentary letter of credit issued via SWIFT MT700, or a bank payment undertaking under an SBP-licensed confirming bank. Payments to Apple and Google settlement entities may be structured as net-revenue remittances from the Panamanian entity out of the operating account. For vendor payments denominated in EUR or GBP, the bank executes a spot USD/foreign-currency transaction and the outgoing SWIFT message references the underlying contract and the Panamanian RUC. All outbound payments must preserve the transaction trail between board-approved contracts, invoices, and final credit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Cross-currency swaps in USD/EUR and USD/GBP under ISDA documentation
FX swaps for short-term liquidity rebalancing between USD and settlement currencies

Non-deliverable forwards in third-country emerging-market currencies, such as USD/CNY or USD/foreign non-convertible pairs, solely to hedge underlying contractual exposures and executed through an SBP-approved counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Tasa Única) — USD 300 standard / USD 400 if authorized capital exceeds USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Republic of Panama — SETA e-filing and e-payment portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March for every existing Sociedad Anónima; first-year pro-rated payment due within three months of incorporation; no anniversary-based extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus 1.5% monthly default interest accruing from 1 April; DGI blocks issuance of Paz y Salvo (good-standing certificate), suspends the RUC taxpayer number and freezes local bank operations; after approximately 3–5 years of unresolved non-payment, the company is subject to administrative strike-off from the Registro Público de Panamá.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Management Report (Informe de Gestión de Personas Jurídicas) — mandatory corporate, economic-activity and beneficial-owner (UBO) declaration imposed by Law 254 of 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (Beneficial Ownership Registry), Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 31 March; data must mirror the share register as of 31 December of the preceding year and capture all share transfers executed during that year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or deficient filing: administrative fines of USD 200–1,000; incomplete or false UBO information: fines up to USD 50,000; RUC suspended, tax certificates withheld, and repeated non-compliance is a basis for strike-off by the Registro Público de Panamá.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta, DGI form) — zero return required even if no Panama-source revenue is generated by the ISIC 5820 social-casino business model
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance — SETA electronic tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after the close of the fiscal year; for calendar-year companies, on or before 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file: fine of 25%–50% of any tax due, with a minimum administrative fine of USD 100 for zero-return cases; 10% late-payment surcharge plus 1.5% monthly default interest; open delinquency blocks Paz y Salvo issuance and prevents corporate cancellations or registered transfers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit by a Panamanian certified public accountant (Contador Público Autorizado idóneo) is mandatory when gross annual income or total assets exceed USD 3,000,000 (Law 129 of 2020), or when specifically ordered by the DGI; a sub-threshold social-casino IP holding S.A. carries no mandatory audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (NIIF) for listed and large entities; IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) for the standard S.A.; accounting records must be maintained under Law 52 of 2016 and Law 254 of 2021, kept in Spanish, and located in Panama.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each S.A. must file the annual Informe de Gestión with the DGI by 31 March, confirming the registered agent, directors, shareholders, and every ultimate beneficial owner (natural persons with direct or indirect interest of 10% or more, or exercising control); each share transfer executed during the preceding fiscal year must be entered in the statutory share register and disclosed in the annual report; the resident agent is jointly liable for accurate UBO disclosure, and non-compliance may trigger fines up to USD 50,000 plus suspension of good standing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Share Transfer Ledger (Libro de Acciones y sus Transferencias)
Register of Officers and Secretary (Libro de Funcionarios)
Minutes Book of Shareholder and Board Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y Junta Directiva)
Statutory Accounting Books — Journal and Ledger (Libro Diario y Libro Mayor)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–650 per annum for resident agent and registered office services in Panama (standard S.A. corporate package)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 where the revenue/asset audit threshold is not met; USD 4,000–10,000 for a simple S.A. if a certified statutory audit becomes compulsory under Law 129 of 2020

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax on net Panama-source taxable income; a graduated statutory schedule applies to net taxable income not exceeding B/. 1,500,000.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific holiday for simulated social casino publishers; effective rate relief derives from territorial source rules (foreign-source digital dissemination income may fall outside the Panamanian net), accelerated depreciation on software and hardware, deductibility of Apple IAP and Google Play Billing platform commissions, the Law 41/2007 Multinational Headquarters (SEM) incentive, and Panama Pacifico benefits for qualifying establishments; residual effective rate converges to 25% on Panama-source profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario D-02 / Declaración Jurada Anual del Impuesto sobre la Renta de Personas Jurídicas, lodged exclusively through the e-Tax 2.0 web portal of the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) / Autoridad Nacional de Ingresos Públicos (ANIP).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before March 15 of the year immediately following the fiscal year-end for calendar-year taxpayers (i.e., the fifteenth day of the third month after December 31); taxpayers maintaining a different fiscal year-end must file within the equivalent three-month statutory window.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Único de Contribuyentes number, corporate legal name, registered tax domicile, and the audited fiscal year covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Panamanian RUC of the S.A.; non-resident shareholders do not populate any RUC field because the return is entity-level only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross receipts from simulated casino app sales and virtual slots content net of Apple IAP and Google Play Billing store commissions, including any Panamanian advertising or licensing revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Panama-source receipts; support foreign-source attribution with server-location, contract, and customer-location evidence where revenue is booked through a foreign distribution hub or overseas app storefront.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reasonable and documented costs: platform store fees, payment-processing charges, cloud hosting, employee salaries and social security, amortization of game-development intangibles, lawfully contracted royalties, and general operating expenses deductible under the territorial accrual method.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions are disallowed to the extent paid to non-residents without proper withholding certificates, treaty TRC files, or evidence of economic substance of the foreign payee; related-party payments must satisfy transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama-source gross receipts reduced by deductible costs, amortization, and net operating loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a negative balance arises, the loss may be carried forward against future Panama-source income for a maximum of 5 fiscal years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the 25% headline rate to net taxable income; taxpayers under the B/. 1,500,000 net-income threshold apply the graduated scale.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No special non-resident rate applies; the Panamanian S.A. is the sole taxpayer on this return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly partial payments, ITBMS credits, withholdings borne by the company, and any treaty-recognized foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach schedules of withholdings applied to payments made to non-resident counterparties; the S.A. may not claim a credit for Panamanian dividend withholding taxes imposed on distributions to shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final settlement after credits and prepayments; payment must be made electronically through e-Tax 2.0 within the same statutory deadline.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot net personal taxes or home-jurisdiction losses against the corporate balance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Extemporaneous filing attracts a fine of 5% of the tax due for the first month of delay and 10% from the second month onward, plus a monthly interest surcharge of 1.5% on the unpaid balance; willful non-filing may trigger a DGI/ANIP ex officio assessment, a 100% surcharge for fraudulent omission, and registration of a tax lien in the Registro Público.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario de Pago Parcial / Anticipo del Impuesto sobre la Renta (e-Tax 2.0 module 'Pagos Parciales').
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Installments due on April 15, June 15, September 15, and December 15 of the in-force fiscal year, computed on the lower of 25% of actual cumulative Panama-source income or the prior-year benchmark.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the covered calendar quarter and the RUC of the taxpayer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Entity-level form only; no non-resident data is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Year-to-date Panama-source net taxable income determined on the same territorial attribution rules as the annual return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute using the same foreign-source exclusion criteria and supporting contracts applied to Line 1a of Formulario D-02.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly estimated installment payable to the ANIP treasury account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prepayments constitute a corporate asset and are not a final tax on non-resident shareholders or group entities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-payment or underpayment of quarterly installments generates monthly recalculated interest of 1.5% plus a one-time 10% fine on the deficiency; persistent non-performance authorizes the tax administration to issue garnishments against payment rails, including Apple IAP and Google Play Billing remittances.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 5% final withholding on gross dividends declared or paid from Panama-source profits; a complementary additional withholding may arise when the distributed profits have been taxed at an effective rate below the 25% headline corporate rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must furnish a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the competent authority of its residence state, together with the completed treaty relief application form, to the Panamanian S.A. before each distribution; the S.A., acting as withholding agent, must retain the TRC, record the treaty-allocated rate in corporate books, and report the application via e-Tax 2.0. Panama's DTA network (Netherlands, Spain, Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Qatar, UAE, Luxembourg, France, Portugal, Italy, among others) generally reserves dividend taxing rights to the residence state, but in the absence of an effective DTA the full 5% domestic rate applies and no foreign certificate can supersede domestic law.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and license fees on game IP, software, and virtual slots content paid to non-residents are subject to a 12.5% statutory withholding on the Panama-source gross payment; DTA-dependent reduction to generally 5%-10% on royalties is available upon TRC and beneficial-ownership substantiation. Interest on cross-border debt carries a 6% statutory withholding on interest paid to related non-resident lenders, while arm's-length interest paid to unrelated foreign financial institutions is typically exempt; applicable treaties may reduce or eliminate the 6% where the lender is the beneficial owner.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and sworn transfer pricing disclosure arise for taxpayers whose related-party transactions exceed B/. 1,000,000 per fiscal year or whose annual gross revenue exceeds B/. 3,000,000 (Balboa legal tender at 1:1 with the U.S. dollar); group Master File and Country-by-Country reporting obligations attach to multinational groups meeting consolidated revenue thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Ley 254 de 2021 and implementing ANIP resolutions) require an S.A. engaged in digital software licensing and geographically mobile service activity to demonstrate local direction and management, physical premises, full-time personnel of adequate qualification, and local expenditure proportionate to income; the annual ESR report is filed through e-Tax 2.0, and a pure IP-holding structure with no Panamanian control over the gaming intangibles is treated as non-substantive, losing treaty access and facing strike-off.
